Beveridge Williams.notes: Careers page promotes an ongoing Engineering Development Program but the job board runs on a JS-only Workit portal that could not be read; a separately found LinkedIn ad for Graduate Civil Engineer redirected to trk=expired_jd_redirect (confirmed expired), so no open junior role was verified.

Taylors Development Strategists.notes: Site's own careers pages list no postings; live roles found via its Dreamwork ATS (dreamworkhq.com/c/taylorsconsulting.com.au) are Senior Landscape Architect, Surveyor - Construction Engineering and Senior Surveyor - Engineering Design Survey, none junior/civil-engineer relevant.

Spiire.notes: Job board (spiire.elmotalent.com.au/careers/spiire/jobs) currently lists only Expressions of Interest - Civil Engineering (Townsville, EOI not a role), Student Town Planner (Brisbane), and Graduate Surveyor (Geelong) - no open graduate/junior civil engineer or drafter role.

Reeds Consulting.notes: Careers page explicitly states there are currently no new vacancies; only accepts speculative expressions of interest.

Tonkin Consulting.notes: Current opportunities list is Civil Program Lead (NSW), Principal Structural Engineer (Sydney), Senior Civil Engineer (Adelaide) and Senior Maritime Structural Engineer (Sydney) - all senior/lead roles, no graduate or junior openings.

Calibre Group.notes: Calibre Group was acquired by WSP Global in June 2023; its careers URL now 301-redirects to WSP's main site, so no standalone Calibre careers page or Calibre-branded junior civil roles exist to check.

Winslow Constructors.notes: blocked_prior_outreach (Winslow Group undergraduate/graduate APPLICATION_UNDER_REVIEW 2026-09-27). Ballarat/Warrnambool cadet ads open via Move To More / Prosple; Prosple eligibility lists Citizen/PR.

Symal.notes: Ignite 2027 intake closed; reopens March 2027. Eligibility requires Australian or New Zealand citizen or permanent resident.

Civilex.notes: Civilex operates under Symal; same Ignite pathway. No separate open junior Civilex advert found this tick.

Bild Group.notes: The browse-careers page server-renders a title/department/location list: Estimator, Senior Estimator, Field Service Mechanic, HSE Advisor x2, Labourer, Multiskilled Plant Operator, Project Manager, Skid Steer/Bobcat Operator, Spreader Truck Operator, Supervisor - no graduate/junior/cadet/trainee/drafter title. The plain 'Estimator' (Campbellfield VIC HQ) is the closest match to 'junior estimator (civil)', but every individual HiBob job page is a client-only SPA that returned no readable advert text on repeated WebFetch and curl attempts, so its seniority/requirements could not be confirmed and no record was created.

Delplant.notes: Careers page read in full. Open roles: Labourers, Pipelayers, Plant Operators, Crew Leaders, Project Managers & Project Engineers (engineering/construction management degree plus minimum 5 years construction and water-industry experience - not junior), and a Truck Driver (Narre Warren). No graduate/junior/cadet/trainee/drafting role listed.

TGM Group.notes: tgmgroup.com and tgmgroup.com.au both failed on every attempt (TLS connection reset / proxy connect_rejected), so no page could be read at all. Background found via search: TGM Group Pty Ltd (Hawthorn VIC land-development engineering consultancy) was acquired by Cardno in 2018 and traded as 'Cardno TGM'; Cardno's ANZ operations were then acquired by Stantec in 2021. TGM likely no longer trades as an independent employer with its own careers page, which is consistent with the dead domain, but this could not be directly confirmed.

Robert Bird Group Pty Ltd.notes: Workday JSON-LD readable; ANZ employment@ cycle currently closed.
